candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that assigns totalDistributed to the owner's balance, so the owner never receives the initial distributed supply.
Delete the balance-credit statement in distr so recipients' balances are never increased during distribution.
Replace the balance-increment with an assignment, overwriting any existing balance of the recipient instead of adding to it.
Delete the statement that decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender], so the allowance is no longer reduced by transfers.
Replace the allowance decrement with an assignment that sets allowed[_from][msg.sender] directly to _amount.
Replace the allowance decrement with an increment, adding _amount to allowed[_from][msg.sender] instead of subtracting it.
Change the blacklist assignment to set false instead of true, so callers never get blacklisted.
Delete the statement that blacklists the investor after receiving tokens, leaving blacklist false for callers.
Invert the condition guarding the blacklist write so callers only get blacklisted when toGive is zero.
Invert the onlyWhitelist requirement so only blacklisted addresses pass, making first-time getTokens calls revert and their blacklist entry stay false.
Invert canDistr to require distributionFinished, making getTokens revert while distribution is open so blacklist is never set.
